items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Used to sing in the band with us... Joe Lawrence. Boy used to sing in the band with Papa Sulla

ctx.x: You know, chick, what I was trying to figure out how they call that boy that lost his mind. Used to sing in the band with us. I was talking to Bill one night, never could think of the talk. Joe Lawrence. Joe Lawrence. That's it. Yeah. Boy used to sing in the band with Papa Sulla said, lost his mind.
He lost his mind. Joe Lawrence. Died. Died in Jacksonville.
